delivery_scope_note: Delivery scope (accepted draft draft_9454b51dd34f4495a03d5f21e70b2b06) is the two elementary steps plus their endpoint minima RC_aS_binaphthyl and P_aR_binaphthyl. The two transition structures are first-order saddles and are therefore delivered as attributes of their elementary step (transition_state block: energy, native opt/freq logs, imaginary frequency, geometry, mode identity) instead of as species nodes, because a species-level geometry slot demands a zero-imaginary minimum that a saddle cannot have. The two transition-structure nodes are declared transition_state nodes of the graph and are referenced as the via vertex of each step; they are outside the accepted delivery scope precisely because a species-level geometry slot (zero imaginary frequencies) cannot apply to a first-order saddle - their structures are delivered through each step's ts_opt/frequency evidence.
method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, Gaussian 16, gas phase, closed shell, charge 0, multiplicity 1, C20H14; electronic energies only (no ZPE, no thermal correction). xTB/GFN2 used only for exploratory scans and seeds.
summary: Thermal racemization of 1,1'-binaphthyl is one elementary torsional (atropisomeric) interconversion about the inter-ring C1-C1' bond: aS -> aR with no bond broken or formed. Channel A (coplanar, achiral TS) costs 23.48 kcal/mol electronic and is the operative path at ~50 degC; channel B (peri-H-eclipsed, chiral C2 TS) costs 32.84 kcal/mol. A C1-C1' homolysis/biradical route was computed and excluded.
torsion_convention: Two dihedral conventions are quoted. 'tau_ortho' in this file and in REPORT.md is the task's proxy dihedral 2-10-11-12 (atom 2 is a meta CH of ring A): RC +110.6 deg, channel-A saddle 0.0 deg, channel-B saddle -152.7 deg, P -110.6 deg. The IUPAC ortho/ortho dihedral tau(9,10,11,12) measured on the same geometries is 180 deg minus that value: RC +69.39, channel-A saddle 179.98, channel-B saddle -27.31, P -69.39 deg. The two conventions differ only by the cross-product ordering, and the enantiomer pairing is unchanged.
